native_handoff.command:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -Eeuo pipefail
SOURCE=bcd081f1bb90cd5491c6544734ce0a6504274cc4
RUNNER=85c6bf7068c86adc6044dc3f0175355882e355a9
run_dir=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/shadps4-wave.XXXXXX")
trap 'rm -rf -- "$run_dir"' EXIT
curl --fail --location --retry 3 \
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Chreece/shadPS4/$RUNNER/scripts/shadps4-universal-two-game-check.sh" \
  -o "$run_dir/run.sh"
printf '%s  %s\n' \
  dc766e8000c2b25d1d44d05e966a78b8a8e4ca9be3f0cf87c3039271d26f46f6 \
  "$run_dir/run.sh" | sha256sum --check -
unset SHADPS4_PR117_CAPTURE_ONCE
SHADPS4_TEST_FIRST_GAME=CUSA34384 bash "$run_dir/run.sh" "$SOURCE" build "$RUNNER"
